### Understanding Text-Based Video Editing
Text-based video editing (sometimes called transcript-based editing) allows creators to edit videos the same way they edit a Word document. By deleting, copying, or rearranging sentences in an auto-generated transcript, the corresponding video and audio tracks are automatically cut and rearranged to match. This eliminates the need to fiddle with timeline playheads for rough cuts, saving massive amounts of time for talking heads, podcasts, tutorials, and short-form content.
